segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אַלְמָנָה, בֵּין מִן הָאֵירוּסִין בֵּין מִן הַנִּשּׂוּאִין — מוֹכֶרֶת שֶׁלֹּא בְּבֵית דִּין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A widow, whether» widowed «from betrothal or from marriage, sells» her husband’s property «when not in court.»

segments.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: מִן הַנִּשּׂוּאִין מוֹכֶרֶת שֶׁלֹּא בְּבֵית דִּין, מִן הָאֵירוּסִין לֹא תִּמְכּוֹר אֶלָּא בְּבֵית דִּין, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁאֵין לָהּ מְזוֹנוֹת. וְכֹל שֶׁאֵין לָהּ מְזוֹנוֹת — לֹא תִּמְכּוֹר אֶלָּא בְּבֵית דִּין.
segments.en: «Rabbi Shimon says:» A widow «from marriage sells when not in court,» but a widow «from betrothal may sell only in court, because she does not receive sustenance» from her husband’s property. She receives only her marriage contract, «and anyone who does not receive sustenance may sell only in court.»

moves.summary: A widow sells without court whether from betrothal or marriage
From betrothal she sells only in court, lacking sustenance
moves.about: whether a widow from betrothal may sell her husband's property without court

a widow from betrothal sells only in court
positions.basis: she has no sustenance, and whoever lacks sustenance sells only in court
